body:
since the helper formatValues already slices the list, why not call getCurrentLimit inside the function?

Otherwise I feel like the mapping and slicing still should be two steps.
this should also go in the helper IMO
the slicing can be part of the enhancer
what's meant by this test name?
where is onToggle used?
I'm not sure to follow. WDYM?
It tests that it goes through the subscription lifecycle of the enhancer as expected. We can split this test once we determine the final API.
That's the subscriber of the enhancer. It's the render method bound to its render params in the widgets.
That'd be optimal. What API would you see?
the one function both maps & slices, which I feel should be two tasks.
It does it recursively though, so that's tricky.
hmm, the recursiveness in hierarchical indeed poses a problem. That means that you can not really do much more than wrap the slice? Maybe someone else has an idea
should https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/pull/4204/files#diff-6ea8d65722bc8ade374d1b33d23d90caR252 not use `getCurrentLimit()` too? 🤔

No because `showMore` is not passed to the enhancer. It can be used if we address https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/pull/4204#discussion_r350227854 and that we add `getFacetsLimit()` on top of `getCurrentLimit()`.

- `getCurrentLimit()` would get the UI limit
- `getFacetsLimit()` would get the search parameter computed based on whether `showMore` is provided

> hmm, the recursiveness in hierarchical indeed poses a problem. That means that you can not really do much more than wrap the slice? Maybe someone else has an idea

can you elaborate the problem? I don't understand how it can be a problem.
That seems to be ideal to me
Actually the logic is quite different in each connector for now, so we might not want to extract that yet.
Done in a4ccbb2ba43233b08b0b126a8ae4d51377e83b8e.

What do you think of `checkIsShowingMore`?
I always struggle with naming boolean variable and function returning boolean.
Not sure what's the best.
it could maybe also be a getter on the helper, so it can stay `isShowingMore` instead of a function
